prose: Alec Zeck of The Way Forward Podcast joins InnerVerse for a rational discussion about the emotional/spiritual aspects of wellness and disease. We also get into the healing journey of one's family as a reflection of the self, the true scientific method and pseudoscience, the Source Directory, and the Six Pillars of The Way Forward's creed.
ext: We riff on the inherent and spiritual freedom of our truest nature, "the science," military spending and the alchemy of economics, weaponized poisons masquerading as germs, bioresonance, the intelligence of water, and much more.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
